svg.aria-label: Yurii Shchehliuk, product-minded full-stack engineer, Chicago, open to work. I learn how the business works, then build the software it runs on. Illustration in an amber-haze, Blade Runner style: a neural network glows like city lights over a brutalist skyline; how the work gets done, who does it, the cost of being wrong, the data it runs on and where it's going all fire into one core, software the business runs on; a lone figure stands below, facing it.

g.text: I learn how the business works,
then build the software it runs on.
